# Krishnendu Biswas

Krishnendu Biswas is an AI agent systems builder and machine learning practitioner based in India. He is an MBA candidate at the Indian Institute of Management (IIM) Ranchi, holds a Diploma in Programming from the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Madras BS program, and is a Springer-published researcher.

## Core Competencies
- Multi-Agent Systems Architecture: 12 MECE isolated profiles, loopback model routing gateway, layered memory, and automated reporting.
- Machine Learning Engineering: Imbalanced classification, LightGBM, XGBoost, Random Forest, Optuna hyperparameter optimization, LoRA parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT), DeBERTa-v3, RoBERTa, PyTorch.
- Business Intelligence and Data Modeling: Microsoft Certified Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300), Star Schema, DAX time-intelligence and context filtering.
- Econometrics and Statistical Research: 5-regressor OLS regression in R, chi-square, Kruskal-Wallis, K-Means++ clustering.

## Multi-Agent Systems Case Studies
- Platform Architecture: https://krishnendu.me/work/platform/
  Migration from local M1 Max prototype to Azure Ubuntu VPS with 12 MECE domain profiles and systemd supervision.
- Model Routing and Compute Tiers: https://krishnendu.me/work/routing/
  9Router loopback gateway enforcing deterministic-first script execution, tiered compute, and provider fallback.
- Memory Layers and Reporting: https://krishnendu.me/work/memory/
  Four-tier memory architecture: autobiography ledger (G:0001 to G:0019), persistent state, bge-small vector store, and STAR HTML reporting.
- Reliability, Security and DR: https://krishnendu.me/work/reliability/
  Hourly medic drift audits, encrypted backup capsules, offsite GitHub Releases mirror, and VPS disaster recovery runbook.
- Financial Ingestion and Ledger: https://krishnendu.me/work/finance/
  Deterministic digital receipt ingestion from read-only Gmail into idempotent transactions in self-hosted Firefly III.
- LinkedIn Studio: https://krishnendu.me/work/linkedin-studio/
  Voice drafting, humanizer anti-AI writing style pass, mandatory human review, and manual publishing.

## Machine Learning Projects
- Toxic Comment Classification: https://krishnendu.me/projects/comment-classification/
  198K comments, 100-trial Optuna study (0.807 CV F1), and Nelder-Mead 3-model blend reaching 0.8293 F1-Macro on 39.6K held-out rows.
- Customer Exit Prediction: https://krishnendu.me/projects/customer-exit/
  Benchmarked 8 classifiers over 90,000 banking records; tuned Random Forest won with 0.6365 validation F1 (0.6456 CV F1).
- Smart MCQ Solver: https://krishnendu.me/projects/mcq/
  LoRA fine-tuning (r=8, alpha=16) on DeBERTa-v3 and RoBERTa in a 70:30 ensemble scoring 0.74242 MAP@3 on Kaggle leaderboard.
- VC Deal Analytics: https://krishnendu.me/projects/vc-dashboard/
  3-page Power BI dashboard with 7 DAX measures and 50,000-row synthetic star schema.
- Consumer Spend Segmentation: https://krishnendu.me/projects/consumer-spend/
  K-Means++ clustering on 62 respondents into 5 spend personas with 0.540 silhouette score.
- Internal Migration in India: https://krishnendu.me/projects/migration/
  5-regressor OLS regression in R across 28 Indian states showing income, poverty, and unemployment significant at 5%.
